items.source: If one of the corresponding annotations is found in the superclass hierarchy of the root declaring class, that will be returned. Otherwise, an attempt will be made to find a corresponding annotation in the enclosing class hierarchy of the root declaring class if appropriate.
items.translation: 如果根声明类的超类层次结构中存在对应的注解之一，则返回该注解。否则，若适当，将尝试在根声明类的封闭类层次结构中查找对应的注解。

items.source: Throws an UnsupportedOperationException since the type of annotation represented by an UntypedAnnotationDescriptor is unknown.
items.translation: 由于由 `UntypedAnnotationDescriptor` 表示的注解类型未知，因此会抛出 `UnsupportedOperationException`。

items.source: Find the next TestContextAnnotationUtils.UntypedAnnotationDescriptor for the specified annotation types in the hierarchy above the root declaring class of this descriptor.
items.translation: 查找指定注解类型在描述符的根声明类 root declaring class 之上的层次结构中的下一个 TestContextAnnotationUtils.UntypedAnnotationDescriptor。

items.source: next in class TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor<Annotation>
items.translation: next 类 TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor<Annotation>

items.source: findAllLocalMergedAnnotations in class TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor<Annotation>
items.translation: findAllLocalMergedAnnotations 类 TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor<Annotation>

items.source: the next corresponding annotation descriptor if one of the annotations was found; otherwise null
items.translation: 如果找到其中一个注解，则返回下一个对应的注解描述符；否则为null。

items.source: Untyped extension of TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor that is used to describe the declaration of one of several candidate annotation types where the actual annotation type cannot be predetermined.
items.translation: Untyped 扩展了 TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor，用于描述多个候选注解类型之一的声明，而实际注解类型无法预先确定。

items.source: the set of all merged, synthesized Annotations found, or an empty set if none were found
items.translation: 所有合并、合成的 `Annotations` 的集合，如果未找到则返回空集。
